other_conditions: Must be enrolled in a graduate or post‑graduate degree program in Engineering, Management, Law, Science or Renewable Energy at a recognized university/institution in India or abroad.
Must be working in the Renewable Energy sector in national, international or non‑governmental organisations.
Interns cannot repeat or extend the internship.
MNRE may relax any of the above conditions for deserving candidates.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹15,000 per month for physical internships, along with a completion certificate and logistical support such as internet access.
